summary.text: Spencer Stone is the Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican J.T. Waggoner.
A public school teacher and coach, he says he is running on public education, workforce development and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Spencer Stone graduated from Pelham High School, earned a graduate degree from the University of Montevallo in 2011 and a Ph.D. from the University of Alabama in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an educator and business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a public school teacher, coach and community-focused problem-solver, and an earlier version of his response described him as an educator, technology entrepreneur and community advocate who teaches computer science.
Stone advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
In the survey, he said he is running to support public education and teachers, to prepare students for college, careers and skilled trades, and to make government more transparent and accountable.
